arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, replace

# Comprehensive tests for all requirements

print('=== R1: Immutability ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
for attr in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
    try:
        setattr(v, attr, 99)
        print(f'FAIL: v.{attr} should be immutable')
    except AttributeError:
        print(f'PASS: v.{attr} raises AttributeError on assignment')

print()
print('=== R2: Iteration ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
result = list(v)
expected = [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1']
assert result == expected, f'Expected {expected}, got {result}'
print(f'PASS: list(v) = {result}')

print()
print('=== R3: Comparison with tuple ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
assert v == (1, 2, 3), 'Should equal tuple'
assert not (v < (1, 2, 3)), 'Should not be less than equal tuple'
assert v <= (1, 2, 3), 'Should be less or equal'
assert not (v > (1, 2, 3)), 'Should not be greater'
assert v >= (1, 2, 3), 'Should be greater or equal'
assert v != (2, 0, 0), 'Should not equal different tuple'
print('PASS: All tuple comparisons work correctly')

print()
print('=== R4: Bump methods ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
bumps = [
    ('bump_major', lambda x: x.bump_major(), VersionInfo(2, 0, 0, 'alpha', 'build.1')),
    ('bump_minor', lambda x: x.bump_minor(), VersionInfo(1, 3, 0, 'alpha', 'build.1')),
    ('bump_patch', lambda x: x.bump_patch(), VersionInfo(1, 2, 4, 'alpha', 'build.1')),
]
for name, method, expected in bumps:
    result = method(v)
    assert result == expected, f'{name}: Expected {expected}, got {result}'
    print(f'PASS: {name}() = {result}')

# bump_prerelease and bump_build need separate handling since they modify prerelease/build
vp = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
bp_result = vp.bump_prerelease()
assert bp_result.prerelease == 'rc.1', f'Expected rc.1, got {bp_result.prerelease}'
print(f'PASS: bump_prerelease() = {bp_result}')

vb = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
bb_result = vb.bump_build()
assert bb_result.build == 'build.1', f'Expected build.1, got {bb_result.build}'
print(f'PASS: bump_build() = {bb_result}')

print()
print('=== R5: Type conversion ===')
v = VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 'alpha', 'build.1')
assert isinstance(v.major, int)
assert isinstance(v.minor, int)
assert isinstance(v.patch, int)
assert isinstance(v.prerelease, str)
assert isinstance(v.build, str)
print('PASS: All types correct after string input')

# Test None values
v2 = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, None, None)
assert v2.prerelease is None
assert v2.build is None
print('PASS: None values preserved')

print()
print('=== R6: CLI functions ===')
import semver
assert hasattr(semver, 'createparser'), 'Missing createparser'
assert hasattr(semver, 'main'), 'Missing main'
assert hasattr(semver, 'process'), 'Missing process'
assert callable(semver.createparser)
assert callable(semver.main)
assert callable(semver.process)
print('PASS: All CLI functions exposed')

print()
print('=== R7: Replace function and method ===')
# Module-level replace function
result = replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', major=2, minor=5)
assert result == '2.5.3-alpha+build', f'Expected 2.5.3-alpha+build, got {result}'
print(f'PASS: replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", major=2, minor=5) = {result}')

# VersionInfo.replace method
vi = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
new_vi = vi.replace(major=2, patch=9)
assert new_vi == VersionInfo(2, 2, 9, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print(f'PASS: vi.replace(major=2, patch=9) = {new_vi}')

print()
print('=== ALL REQUIREMENTS VERIFIED ===')
"
